verses.text: Ha heb' winh yajal ix kot wet' t'a Babilonia ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal, haton sb'i heb' winh tik icha tas yaj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh t'a junjun yinhtilal:

Haton winhaj Gersón, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Finees. Winhaj Daniel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Itamar. Winhaj Hatús, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Secanías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj David. Winhaj Zacarías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Paros, 150 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Elioenai yuninal winhaj Zeraías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Pahat-moab, 200 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Secanías yuninal winhaj Jahaziel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Zatu, 300 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Ebed yuninal winhaj Jonatán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Adín, 50 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Jesaías yuninal winhaj Atalías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Elam, 70 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Zebadías yuninal winhaj Micael, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Sefatías, 80 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Jehiel, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Joab, 218 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Josifías, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bani, 160 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Bebai, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bebai, 28 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Hacatán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Azgad, 110 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh. Ha winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Jeiel yet' winhaj Semaías t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Adonicam, tzak'anxo ix meltzaj heb' winh yet' 60 heb' winh winak. Winhaj Utai yet' winhaj Zabud, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Bigvai, 70 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh.

Ha in Esdras in tik, ix in molb'ej heb' wetchonhab' tik t'a sti' jun ha ha' skuchan Ahava, oxe' k'ual onh ek' ta'. Ix in sayanek' heb' levita t'a skal heb' anima chi' yet' t'a skal heb' sacerdote, malaj junok heb' ix ilchaj wuuj.

Ix in chekanb'at winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Ariel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Elnatán, winhaj Natán, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Mesulam. Ha heb' winh tik niwak yelk'och heb' winh yet' pax heb' winh k'ayb'um, haton winhaj Joiarib yet' winhaj Elnatán.

Ix in chekb'at heb' winh yal t'a winhaj Iddo, yajal t'a jun lugar skuch Casifia yet' t'a masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh ta', haton heb' yinhtilal heb' munlajnak t'a stemplo Dios to schekkot heb' anima heb' yik skolwaj heb' ket'ok t'a skajnub' ko Diosal.

Yuj skolwal Dios ix ik'chajkot winhaj Serebías yuj heb' winh, yujto a winh chi' te jelan winh, yinhtilal winh jun winh levita skuchan Mahli. Ha winhaj Serebías chi', ix kot winh yet' heb' yuninal yet' heb' yuk'tak, 18 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix yik'anpaxkot winhaj Hasabías heb' winh yet' winhaj Jesaías yet' pax yuninal heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok heb' winh, 20 heb' t'a smasanil, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Merari.
Ix jawipax 220 heb' yinhtilal heb' munlajnak t'a templo, heb' ak'b'ilkanoch yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' skuchb'an heb' levita t'a yopisio. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, tz'ib'ab'il sb'i heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walani to tzonh och t'a tzek'ojk'olal t'a sti' ha' niwan Ahava chi', yik wach' sko cha ko mulej ko chukal t'a yichanh ko Diosal, sko k'ananpax t'ay to tzonh yik'b'at t'a wach'il yet' heb' kuninal yet' masanil tas ay t'ayonh.

Ix in q'uixwi in k'anan heb' soldado t'a winh rey, haton heb' sb'ey t'a yok yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, yik tzonh stanhwan heb' t'a heb' ajk'ol t'a yoltak b'e, yujto toxo ix kal t'a winh rey chi' to a ko Diosal stanhwan masanil mach tz'ak'anoch yipok sk'ool, palta skot yowal, syak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh mach max k'anab'ajani.
Yuj wal chi', ix onh och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix ko k'anan t'a Dios to tzonh stanhwej. Ix yab' wal tas ix kal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix in sik'anel lajchawanh heb' winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Serabías, winhaj Hasabías yet' lajunhwanhxo heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wechtan juntzanh silab' ix ak'chaj yuj sb'ochajxi stemplo ko Diosal, ix in pukanb'at t'a lajchawanh heb' winh sacerdote ix in sik'el chi'. Ha juntzanh silab' chi', ay k'een plata, k'een oro yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ix yak' winh rey yet' heb' tz'ak'an srazón winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet' winh yet' pax tastak ix yak' heb' ketisraelal ayek' ta'. Ha t'a smasanil, ay 500 quintal k'een plata. Yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a plata, 75 quintal yalil yet' 75 quintal k'een oro yet' pax 20 uk'ab' oro, 17 libra yalil yet' chab'xo yamk'ab' bronce te wach' yaj sb'oi, lajan stojol icha yamk'ab' oro.
Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex tik sik'b'il exxo el yikok Jehová yet' juntzanh k'een oro, k'een plata yet' masanil yamk'ab' ix siaj t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham.

Tze tanhwej wal k'een masanto ol echtaj k'een t'a yoltak scuartoal templo t'a Jerusalén t'a yichanh heb' yajalil heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' ketisraelal, xin chi t'a heb' winh.

Yuj chi' a heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita chi', ix schaan masanil k'een silab' heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' ix echtaj chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yik syik'anb'at heb' winh t'a skajnub' ko Diosal t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik slajchawil k'ual t'a b'ab'el uj, ix onh el t'a sti' ha' Ahava chi', ix onh kot t'a Jerusalén tik. Ha ko Diosal ix onh kolan t'a heb' ajk'ool yet' t'a heb' elk'um t'a yoltak b'e.
Ayik ix onh jawi t'a Jerusalén tik, oxe' k'ual ix kik' kip.

Haxo t'a schanhil k'ual jun, ix onh b'at t'a skajnub' ko Diosal yik tz'echtaj k'een plata yet' k'een oro yet' jantak yamk'ab' yik skajnub' ko Diosal chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chaj t'a winh sacerdote skuchan Meremot yuninal winhaj Urías. Aypaxek' winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Finees yet' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Jozabad yuninal winhaj Jesúa yet' winhaj Noadías yuninal winhaj Binúi.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix echtaj k'een, ix b'ischajpax k'een smasanil, tz'akan yaj k'een. Icha chi' ix aj stz'ib'chajkan k'een smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix jax t'a Babilonia, ix yak'an nok' silab' heb' stz'a smasanil t'a ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik. Ix ak'chaj lajchawanh nok' kelemtak wakax kuuj ko masanil, 96 nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 77 nok' kelemtak kalnel. Ix ak'chaj pax lajchawanh nok' mam chiwa silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup mul. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix nhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'chaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'il scheknab'il winh rey t'a heb' ayoch yajalil t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates, yuj chi' a heb' ix kolwaj ket'ok t'a munlajel t'a stemplo ko Diosal.
